questions.stem: A square of side 8 is scaled to 75% of its size. What is the new side length?
A shape is rotated by $\frac38$ of a full turn. How many degrees is that?
questions.explain: A full turn is 360°, and 3/8 of 360 is 3 × 45 = 135.

questions.stem: Translate the point (3, 2) by the vector (−1, 4). Where does it land?
questions.explain: Add the vectors component by component: (3 + (−1), 2 + 4) = (2, 6).

questions.stem: Turning a point 90° anticlockwise about the origin is done by the matrix $R=\begin{pmatrix}0&-1\\1&0\end{pmatrix}$. Compute $R\begin{pmatrix}3\\2\end{pmatrix}$.
questions.explain: Each row of R is dotted with (3, 2). Row 1 gives 0·3 + (−1)·2 = −2 and row 2 gives 1·3 + 0·2 = 3, so the point is (−2, 3).

questions.stem: Every side of a square is tripled. By what factor does its area grow?
questions.explain: Area scales with the square of the length ratio, so the area becomes 3² = 9 times as large.
